notes.title: One Dreamer: Demo Infinite Runner Competition
notes.content:
Please Note: To participate you need to download One Dreamer: Demo as the mini-game isn't available in One Dreamer: Prologue.

Win a copy of One Dreamer + your name/alias in the game!

Finish in the top 3 of the NXT arcade game’s leaderboard to win!

To enter download One Dreamer’s limited time demo and go to the arcade area where the new NXT infinite runner mini-game is located.

This competition will only be available during the Steam Next Fest (June 13-20, 2022) and the final leaderboard results will be locked in once the event has finished.

Notes:
- A tied score for any of the top 3 ranks will result in both/all players winning.
- Winners will be contacted via Steam Chat.
- The NXT mini-game is only available in One Dreamer: Demo (June 13-20, 2022).

notes.title: 1.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changes:

- Update movement system and run animation
- Add ability to select variables directly from the code view
- Add special indicators when near other platforms
- Add special indicator when close to codable objects
- Add splash screen and epilepsy warning
- Add ’Edit Code’ label to all codable objects
- Update string ‘ ’ syntax styling in code files
- Add position watchdog
- Add horizontal movement on steps
- Add icons to clipboard
- Add SFX to apply/revert settings
- Add SFX to Game Data Menu
- Add map to lobby area
- Update transition effects into and out of the studio area
- Update dev commentary
- Add ‘new’ notifications indicator to Todo and Email app
- Updated social links in credits

Bugfixes:

- Fix Frank animation bug if enter rowboat from too far away
- Fix option menu borders off by 1px
- Fix secret area camera tracking bug
- Fix sprite sorting order on steps in the lobby
- Update [-----].mp3

notes.title: 1.0.4 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.0.4 Patch Notes

Changes:

- Added Point & Click selection (enabled by default).
- Added option to switch to old selection system in Menu/options.

Bugfixes:

- Fixed interaction label not disappearing when closing code editor without any code files selected.

notes.title: 1.0.3 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.0.3 Patch Notes

Changes:

- Starting a new game with the speedrun timer enabled skips opening cutscene (doesn’t affect final speedrun times).
- Luna makes less comments during the PADDLE match and several are only triggered at special events (e.g. after not being able to score a single point in 3 consecutive rounds).
- Can use the Esc key to close pause menu menu.

Bugfixes:

- Fixed spelling mistakes.
- Rank error in speedrun message when user didn’t get a PB.
- Look circle not disappearing after viewing drawing/Speedrun info.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.0.1 Patch Notes

Additions:

 Added Linux support (please let me know if you have any issues)
 Added New Game/Continue option in menu
 Added native 4k resolution option


Changes:

 Changed ‘hold tab’ to ‘press tab’ to view object files
 Changed subtitles to enabled by default

 Toned down the speedrun banter at the end of a run (Australian humour might not translate well)


Bugfixes:

 Fixed spelling mistakes
 Fixed bug that occasionally displayed the wrong percentage on the speedrun timer (didn’t effect final percentage)

notes.title: One Dreamer: Prologue Is Live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37397649/e29a3765390f42d5d73c423c129f788b875b7298.png

Please let me know if you encounter any bugs so I can fix them promptly.

I’m also open to feedback and already have a backlog of improvements to make.

These include:
- Tighter selection system
- Running animation
- Controller support
- Audio levels settings
- Brightness levels settings

Thank you for all your support,
Gareth

For more frequent updates follow the game on twitter:
@OneDreamerGame
